---
title: "Invitation offered among selected patients"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
models_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
figures_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_path <- file.path(models_dir, "invitation-offered.rds")
```

## Model data

- Offered means an answer (accepted or declined) is recorded.

```{r}
#| label: model-data

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)

model_data <- cohort |>
  filter(tx == 1) |>
  select(invitation_offered, tx, age, gender) |>
  mutate(gender = factor(gender))
```

## Model fit

```{r}
#| label: fit

if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  fit <- brm(
    invitation_offered ~ age + gender,
    data = model_data,
    family = bernoulli("logit"),
    iter = 2000L,
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 1L,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting,
    refresh = 0L
  )
  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}

fit <- readRDS(model_path)
```

## Standardized probability

```{r}
#| label: standardized-probability

offered_draws <- avg_predictions(
  fit,
  newdata = model_data,
  type = "response",
  re_formula = NA
) |>
  get_draws() |>
  select(draw)

offered_summary <- offered_draws |>
  summarise(
    outcome = "standardized_invitation_offered_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(draw),
    posterior_median = median(draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
    n_model = nrow(model_data),
    n_selected = sum(cohort$tx == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write_parquet(
  offered_draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "invitation-offered-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  offered_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "invitation-offered-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: offered-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior standardized probability of invitation being offered"
#| echo: false

kable(offered_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-offered-posterior
#| fig-cap: "Posterior standardized probability of invitation being offered. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "A half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the age- and sex-standardized probability that an invitation was offered among selected patients, in percent, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# No reference line: a probability has no natural reference value.
offered_posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  100 * offered_draws$draw,
  x_label = "Probability of invitation being offered, %",
  reference = NULL
)

save_figure(
  offered_posterior_plot,
  file.path(figures_dir, "invitation-offered-posterior.png"),
  height = 5
)
offered_posterior_plot
```

## Predictions by gender

- Descriptive: each gender keeps its own observed age distribution.

```{r}
#| label: offered-gender-predictions

fit <- set_modeldata(fit, fit$data)

gender_draws <- avg_predictions(fit, by = "gender", type = "response") |>
  get_draws() |>
  select(gender, drawid, draw)

gender_summary <- gender_draws |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  summarise(
    posterior_mean = mean(draw),
    posterior_median = median(draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_parquet(
  gender_draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "invitation-offered-gender-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  gender_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "invitation-offered-gender-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-offered-gender-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive probability of invitation being offered by gender"
#| echo: false

kable(gender_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-offered-gender-predictions
#| fig-cap: "Descriptive posterior probability of invitation being offered by gender. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Posterior half-eye densities and dot plots of the probability that an invitation was offered, in percent, shown in separate panels for each gender, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

gender_predictions_plot <- plot_posterior(
  gender_draws |> mutate(draw = 100 * draw, panel = gender),
  x_label = "Probability of invitation being offered, %",
  reference = NULL
)

save_figure(
  gender_predictions_plot,
  file.path(figures_dir, "invitation-offered-gender-predictions.png"),
  height = 7
)
gender_predictions_plot
```
